startups/ex-tidewater.name: Tidewater Sensors
startups/ex-tidewater.tagline: Low-cost buoys that warn shellfish farms before the water turns.
startups/ex-tidewater.what: We build small solar buoys that track temperature, oxygen and acidity, and text farmers when conditions put their stock at risk.
startups/ex-tidewater.plan: Run paid pilots with 10 farms in Nova Scotia and PEI, finish the second hardware version, and apply for IRAP support.
startups/ex-tidewater.offers: Hardware prototyping and field testing advice

demos.t: Buoy in the water (2 min video)

updates.text: Fourth pilot farm installed in Mahone Bay.
Second buoy version survived its first storm season.

startups/ex-prairie.name: Prairie Ledger
startups/ex-prairie.tagline: Bookkeeping built for grain farms, from seed costs to crop insurance.
startups/ex-prairie.what: Farm accounting software that pulls in elevator tickets and input invoices so farmers always know their cost per acre.
startups/ex-prairie.plan: Grow from 120 to 600 paying farms, add Manitoba and Alberta, and hire two support staff before seeding season.
startups/ex-prairie.offers: Selling to rural customers, SR&ED claims

startups/ex-portage.name: Portage Health
startups/ex-portage.tagline: Follow-up care by text for patients far from a clinic.
startups/ex-portage.what: Clinics use our tool to check in on patients after a visit by text message, in English, French, Cree and Ojibwe.
startups/ex-portage.plan: Sign three clinic pilots, complete a privacy review, and measure whether follow-ups cut repeat visits.
startups/ex-portage.offers: Health privacy rules, working with clinics

startups/ex-kiln.name: Kiln & Co
startups/ex-kiln.tagline: Refillable home cleaning products delivered across the GTA.
startups/ex-kiln.what: We deliver cleaning concentrates in returnable glass and pick up the empties on the next order.
startups/ex-kiln.plan: Reach 1,000 subscribers, open a second refill depot in Mississauga, and land one grocery partner.

updates.text: Reached 300 subscribers across Brampton and Mississauga.

startups/ex-boreal.name: Boréal Batteries
startups/ex-boreal.tagline: Second-life EV batteries as backup power for remote communities.
startups/ex-boreal.what: We test and repackage used electric vehicle batteries into storage units that replace diesel generators.
startups/ex-boreal.plan: Open a second assembly line, deliver 40 units to northern Quebec and Labrador, and start sales in Ontario.

updates.text: 18th storage unit delivered and switched on.

startups/ex-chinook.name: Chinook Freight
startups/ex-chinook.tagline: Fills empty truck space on Prairie routes.
startups/ex-chinook.what: Small shippers book spare room on trucks already driving between Calgary, Regina and Winnipeg.
startups/ex-chinook.plan: Add Edmonton and Saskatoon lanes, reach 50 carriers, and build automated pricing.

startups/ex-sitka.name: Sitka Learn
startups/ex-sitka.tagline: Short trades-math lessons for apprentices on their phones.
startups/ex-sitka.what: Five-minute lessons that help apprentices pass the math part of their Red Seal exams.
startups/ex-sitka.plan: Find a technical co-founder, test with 50 apprentices, and partner with one college.

startups/ex-northlight.name: Northlight Permits
startups/ex-northlight.tagline: Building permit tracking for small northern towns.
startups/ex-northlight.what: Town offices and builders see every permit, inspection and deadline in one place instead of paper files.
startups/ex-northlight.plan: Sign five municipalities across the territories and add an inspection scheduling tool.

startups/ex-harbourline.name: Harbourline Pay
startups/ex-harbourline.tagline: Same-day pay for fish harvesters and seasonal crews.
startups/ex-harbourline.what: Crews get paid the day the catch lands, and processors settle later through us.
startups/ex-harbourline.plan: Confirm the licensing path, sign one processor as a design partner, and build the first version.

investors/ex-redfife.name: Red Fife Angels
investors/ex-redfife.thesis: Prairie founders solving problems they have lived. We like to see paying customers, even a handful.

investors/ex-granite.name: Granite Shield Ventures
investors/ex-granite.thesis: Seed and Series A in Canadian software companies with early revenue and a clear path to selling outside Canada.

investors/ex-lachine.name: Lachine Canal Capital
investors/ex-lachine.thesis: Patient money for hardware and clean energy companies building in Quebec and Atlantic Canada.
